note: Re-judged 2026-09-30 (independent judge): stale only because the 6-2 tag comment was removed from TestRFC4577CryptographicAuthImplemented; its body and the 6-1 tags are unchanged. Forbidden: a router without working OSPF cryptographic authentication. TestRFC4577CryptographicAuthImplemented signs a Hello with the configured key (md5 and hmac-sha-256) and asserts authStore.verify accepts it; TestRFC4577CryptographicAuthRejectsForgery asserts a tampered digest and a packet signed under another secret are refused, red on an accept-all verifier. The operator SHOULD is row 6-2.
